title_en: Fall 2026 Over-Capacity Course Requests (Choanji) for Electrical and Computer Engineering Courses
summary: Students who wish to take a full course offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering in Fall 2026 must submit an over-capacity (choanji) request on the course registration site (sugang.snu.ac.kr). Undergraduate courses are processed by the department as a batch, and graduate courses are approved by the instructor; after approval, students must confirm enrollment themselves within the period, or the request will not be applied. The application and processing period is not stated in the text of the notice and may be in the attached manual, which was not read.
applies_to: Any student who wishes to submit an over-capacity (choanji) request for a Fall 2026 course offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering. This is optional; it applies only to students who choose to request a place. Students from other departments may request only courses that were not full as of the course registration deadline (August 11, 16:30). Courses offered by interdisciplinary programs and by other departments are handled by those programs or departments, not by this procedure.

dates.what: Course registration deadline. Students from other departments may request only courses that were not full as of this time.

Over-capacity (choanji) application and processing period, including the period for confirming enrollment. The heading appears in the notice, but no dates are given in the text. They may be in the attached manual, which was not read.
dates.when: Not stated in the notice text

conditions: Do not contact the instructors of undergraduate courses individually; the department processes all undergraduate requests together.
Approval received from an undergraduate course instructor by email or by other individual means has no effect on the decision.
Graduate courses offered by the department are approved by the course instructor.
You can only request a course that you have first added to your list of courses of interest.
You may cancel a request only before the instructor approves it, while its status is Applied or Being written (신청&작성중).
If you do not confirm enrollment yourself within the period after approval, the course will not be added to your registration and nothing can be done afterwards.
You may request up to your allowed credits, minus the credits you have already registered, plus 6 credits.
After approval, you may confirm enrollment only within your allowed credit limit.
For an undergraduate course with several sections, requests are rejected if any section still has open places.
If all sections of such a course are full, you may request, but the number of approvals is set in proportion to each section's capacity.

Priority order: first-time takers who are expected to graduate in February 2027 or August 2027 with this department as their major or second major; then first-time takers in the recommended year; then first-time takers in other years; then students retaking the course.
Even students in a priority group may not be approved, depending on how the class is run, the classroom situation and the instructor's opinion.
Students from other departments may request only courses that were not full as of the course registration deadline (August 11, 16:30).

Over-capacity requests will not be approved for these courses: M2608.001500(001) Electrical and Computer Engineering Seminar 2; M2608.001600(001) Electrical and Computer Engineering Seminar 3; 400.019A Introduction to Electrical and Computer Engineering; 430.502 Industrial Applications of Electrical and Electronic Technology; 430.658(003) Special Topics in System Software; M2608.003400 Introduction to Medical Informatics and Medical Artificial Intelligence.
Courses offered by interdisciplinary programs are handled by each program's office, and courses offered by other departments are handled by the department that offers them.
You must read the separate notice on courses with designated prerequisites.
steps: Read the attached manual, '[Attachment] Course Overlap Request Manual (중복수강신청 매뉴얼)' (PDF), for details. Its content was not read for this translation.
Read the required notice on courses with designated prerequisites: https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=57913

Check that the course is not on the list of courses for which requests will not be approved. For courses offered by interdisciplinary programs or other departments, contact that program or department instead.
On the course registration site (http://sugang.snu.ac.kr), add the course you wish to request to your courses of interest (관심강좌).
Go to Course Registration (수강신청) > Over-capacity Request (정원 외 신청) > Write Over-capacity Request (정원 외 신청서 작성).

Register the course for the request by selecting it from your list of courses of interest. Then write your reason for taking the course, in specific terms, including any priority category that applies to you.
Wait for the decision: the department processes undergraduate courses, and the instructor approves graduate courses. Do not contact undergraduate course instructors.
After approval, confirm your enrollment (수강확정) yourself on the course registration site within the period, keeping within your allowed credit limit.
For questions, contact the department's undergraduate office in Building 301, Room 319. The contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
Fall 2026 Procedure for Over-Capacity (Choanji) Requests for Courses Offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

This notice explains how to submit and how the department processes over-capacity (정원 외, choanji 초안지) requests for courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering in Fall 2026. Please read the following carefully before you apply.

Since Spring 2023, the department has operated the over-capacity (choanji) approval procedure as described below. Please take care not to be disadvantaged.

Undergraduate courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering are processed by the department as a batch, under the department's over-capacity approval rules. Do not contact the instructors of undergraduate courses individually. Even if you receive individual approval by email or other means, it will not affect whether your over-capacity (choanji) request is approved. Graduate courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering are approved by the course instructor.

1. Over-capacity (choanji) request: for details, see the '[Attachment]' document.

A. Menu: Course registration site (http://sugang.snu.ac.kr) > Course Registration (수강신청) > Over-capacity Request (정원 외 신청) > Write Over-capacity Request (정원 외 신청서 작성)
- Writing the request: register the course for the over-capacity request (select it from your list of courses of interest, 관심강좌 목록) > enter your reason for taking the course.
※ You must first register the course you wish to request as a course of interest (관심 강좌).
※ Cancelling a request: you may cancel a request before the instructor approves it (status: Applied & Being written, 신청&작성중).
※ When you enter your reason, state specifically why you wish to take the course. If you meet a priority criterion, state this.

B. Procedure: [Student applies] → [Undergraduate courses are processed by the department as a batch / graduate courses are approved by the instructor] → [Student confirms enrollment (수강확정)]*
(*If you do not confirm enrollment yourself within the period, the course will not be added to your registration and nothing can be done afterwards.)

C. Over-capacity (choanji) application and processing period. (No dates are given in the text of the notice. They may be in an image or in the attachment, which was not read.)

D. Credits you may request: your allowed registration credits − the credits you have already registered + 6 credits

E. Credits you may confirm: within your allowed registration credits

2. Criteria for processing over-capacity (choanji) requests for courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

A. Over-capacity (choanji) approval is not first-come, first-served.

B. Undergraduate courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering are processed by the department. Graduate courses are approved by the course instructor.

C. Even if you receive individual approval by email or other means from the instructor of an undergraduate course offered by the department, it will not affect whether your over-capacity (choanji) request is approved.

D. Undergraduate courses offered as several sections of the same course:
- If some sections are not full: over-capacity (choanji) requests are rejected (not approved).
- If all sections are full: you may submit a request, but the number of approvals is set in proportion to the capacity of each section.

E. Priority for over-capacity (choanji) approval:
- First-time takers among students expected to graduate in February 2027 or August 2027 with Electrical and Computer Engineering as their major or second major > first-time takers in the recommended year for the course > first-time takers in other years > students retaking the course
※ However, even students in a priority group may not be approved, depending on how the class is run, the classroom situation and the instructor's opinion.

F. Students from other departments may request only courses that were not full as of the course registration deadline (Tuesday, August 11, 16:30).

3. Other matters

A. Courses with designated prerequisites
※ Must read: https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=57913

B. For over-capacity (choanji) requests for courses offered by interdisciplinary programs, contact the staff of each interdisciplinary program:
- Interdisciplinary Program in Artificial Intelligence Semiconductor Engineering office
- Interdisciplinary Program in Intelligent Communications office
- Interdisciplinary Program in Artificial Intelligence office
(The contact details are in the original notice.)

C. For approval of courses offered by other departments, contact the department that offers the course.

4. Courses for which over-capacity (choanji) requests will not be approved (rejected/not approved):
- M2608.001500(001) Electrical and Computer Engineering Seminar 2 (전기·정보세미나 2)
- M2608.001600(001) Electrical and Computer Engineering Seminar 3 (전기·정보세미나 3)
- 400.019A Introduction to Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기.정보공학개론)
- 430.502 Industrial Applications of Electrical and Electronic Technology (전기전자기술의 산업응용)
- 430.658(003) Special Topics in System Software (시스템소프트웨어특강)
- M2608.003400 Introduction to Medical Informatics and Medical Artificial Intelligence (의료정보와 의료인공지능 개론)

5. Enquiries: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering undergraduate office (Building 301, Room 319). The contact details are in the original notice.

Attachment: Over-capacity Request Manual (Course Overlap Request Manual)
Attached file (1): [Attachment] 중복수강신청 매뉴얼 (Course Overlap Request Manual).pdf (3 MB). The content of this attachment was not read.
